observations: Reviewed native original and private-source driving frames and separate stacked cameras. Muted coastal palette, road shoulders/edge lines and scenery landmarks improve depth and closing-speed readability.
Advance bend cue uses actual ahead-track curvature; 13 behavior checks include state purity, default three-lap gates and lap HUD. No steering, acceleration, drift, collision or source-pixel changes.
Native default full races pass all ordered gates, both controllers, scoring, terminal result and reset. Original/source car art remains distinct from exact-RGB environment colors.
limitations: Lightweight pseudo-3D arcade racer, not realistic vehicle dynamics or a commercial circuit replica.
Original Pole Position qualification, gearing, topology and ROM timing are not implemented.
Historical adapter-only before/after hashes are retained; current scenery is intentionally different and separately labeled.
No physical CRT or human handling study.
